extracted.name: Homemade Potsticker Sauce with Garlic and Ginger
extracted.description: This potsticker sauce is easy to make with soy sauce, rice vinegar, ginger, garlic, hot sauce, and sesame oil for a delicious homemade dip for potstickers.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon finely grated ginger, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, ginger, garlic, sugar, sesame oil, gochujang, green onion, and sesame seeds in a Mason jar. Close the lid and shake until sugar has dissolved.
